cv.name: Camille Arnaud
cv.headline: Business Analyst | Insurance & Digital Processes | ex-Hospitality Operations
cv.summary: Business analyst with two years in insurance digital projects after six years in hotel operations. I turned a front-office background in guest processes and complaint handling into requirements work, process mapping and SQL reporting.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Write user stories and acceptance criteria for the online claims journey with a Scrum team of eight
Mapped the home-insurance claims process in BPMN and cut handover steps from 14 to 9
Build SQL queries and Power BI views to track claim cycle times
Run workshops with claims handlers and the IT supplier to prioritise the backlog

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst (fixed-term)
bullets: Supported requirements gathering for a CRM rollout at a regional bank

experience.title: Front Office Supervisor
bullets: Supervised a team of 7 receptionists in a 120-room hotel
Led the switch to a new property management system and trained staff on it

experience.title: Receptionist
bullets: Guest check-in, billing and complaint handling in French, English and Spanish
